references.text: The verses constitute a direct continuation of the same planning process; verse 36 gives the purpose of storage, while verse 48 describes its execution.
The verses show a direct cause-and-effect relationship: the storage in verse 48 is the only reason Egypt survives the famine described in verse 54.
Direct instruction (verse 35) and its immediate execution (verse 48); they are two sides of the same coin in the story of Joseph's wisdom.
The verses form a theological unity: verse 6 announces the judgment that verse 48 is the concrete answer to, in order to prevent the land from perishing.
